1963: "Construction of the Bowen St building began in 1959, and it was opened in 1963."
1997: "The building was demolished in 1997, and RNZ moved to Radio New Zealand House on The Terrace."
2025: "In 2025 a time capsule which had been buried in the tunnel between the RNZ building and Parliament Buildings in 1996 was discovered and opened."

1975: "Founded in 1975 as the Concert Programme, the network was renamed Concert FM in the mid-1990s, and assumed its current name in 2007 as part of a wider name change within Radio New Zealand to associate Concert FM with the RNZ brand."
